messages:
Nina Park: Quick sync  legal needs the deprecation blurb in the runbook. We're aiming to publish the v1->v2 notice next Wednesday 09:00 PT. Docs tasks: small migration guide, minimal and full SDK snippets, redirect map, and a rollback sentence. Who picks what?
Owen Brooks: I can own the migration guide + rollback sentence. Will add a short canary checklist (smoke tests + error thresholds).
Maya Singh: I'll produce the redirect CSV and run a pre-merge anchor audit. Found a few anchors with punctuation that need explicit ids.
Chris Holt: I'll update Node and Python snippets. Will include a tiny compatibility shim for streaming framing changes and a short note about auth header rename.
Nina Park: Legal, can you paste the approved sentence we must use verbatim?
Legal: Use exactly: "Deprecated endpoints will return HTTP 410 after 2025-07-15; see /docs/migration for migration steps." Do not change punctuation.
Owen Brooks: Adding rollback one-liner to runbook: "If errors spike >0.5% for 10m, revert docs deploy + restore previous redirect CSV + notify #eng-oncall." I'll add who to ping.
Chris Holt: Snippet diff I'm adding to PR (short):
```js
// v1
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
await client.generate({ model: 'legacy-chat', prompt: 'Hello' })
// v2
const client = new Redwood.Client({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN })
await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', input: 'Hello' })
```
Maya Singh: Redirect CSV template: old_path,new_path,owner,fragment_fix. I'll mark rows that need fragment_fix=true. Infra will handle 302->410 timing.
Infra-Bot: Note: we recommend 302 redirects for initial 30 days, then flip to 410 at deprecation date. We can run a staging dry-run when PR label 'redirect-dry-run' is present.
Nina Park: Can someone add an embed migration note? A few customers will have vectors at 256d; v2 uses 512d. Recommend pad with zeros or re-embed.
Chris Holt: Adding a small helper snippet for pad/trim in Python:
```python
# pad/trim helper
def fix_dim(vec, target=512):
    return vec[:target] + [0.0]*max(0, target-len(vec))
```
Owen Brooks: I'll add a short canary plan: deploy docs to staging, run smoke curl (3x regions), check token-error-rate and streaming-frame-loss. If any fail, abort and run rollback steps.
Maya Singh: I'll include a tiny client-side anchor shim in the docs bundle as a temporary fix for encoded anchors. Marked behind feature flag.
Docs-Bot: Reminder: add labels 'deprecation' and 'docs-review' to PRs and attach smoke test artifacts. :robot_face:
Chris Holt: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789  includes snippets, redirect CSV, and pad/trim helper. Please review.
Nina Park: Great. We'll hold announcement until legal + docs-review sign off and staging smoke tests pass. If anyone hits snippet breakage, ping Chris and I'll pause the notice.
